objective: Stand up Layer 4 operational knowledge and the Layer 5 evidence lifecycle with explicit anchor, evidence-class, revision, and re-ingestion contracts.

workstreams.name: Reference decomposition
outputs: decomposed knowledge from attached docs and web snapshots

workstreams.name: Bottom-up canonical reprocessing
outputs: Layer 5 authored artifacts become the canonical source after promotion
meaningful canonical revisions trigger Layer 4 re-ingestion
Layer 3 support and summaries reconcile after canonical changes

exit_criteria: Layer 4 operational knowledge remains source-linked and revision-aware where applicable.
Authored canon is introduced only in the promotion phase.
Canonical revisions can drive reprocessing back into Layer 4 and Layer 3.
risks: Allowing Layer 4 operational work to masquerade as authored canon.
Failing to invalidate stale Layer 3 support after revision changes.
